title: ID0444915-DC/SI-D/SG-[MP / R4 170001689] QA1 Closing Failure
description:
Reported issue:
QA1 Closing Failure
Solution:
Turn on the charger like normal, (QA1 didnt close)
For like a good 2-3 hours.
Ignore the QA1 closure failure
Check at MA1 has L+ 230V and all the wiring to KF2/KF5 is good from the XD9
Check QA28 and QA29 has 230V and watch out for the QA28 QA29 LED light, when I fake door closing and door opening.
Shutdown the charger from the screen
wait for all the led light off
press FC12 (LED light off)
Turn off the QA2 (manual switch off)
Wait a while
Turn on QA2 again
The QA1 MA1 will jump
yyyy-mm-dd: NA

additional_info.subject: URGENT HIGH PRIORITY SiD 170001689: QA1 Closing Failure
additional_info.body:
Dear Expert,
Sicharge D
S/N: 170001689
FW: 7.0.5 (updated via USB)
Network Connection: SIM card
Charger was in storage for about 2 years.
Fault: QA1 Closing Failure when door is closed.
Using Companion tool to debug shows the QA1 is open.
MA1 is blinking orange trip LED and yellow ACT LED.
Rebooting the charger with door closed also do not resolve the issue.
We also have another 2 units 170001687 and 170001510 facing the same issue
This is urgent as we are in the Intertek lab performing the functional testing of the charger before sending it out to New Zealand.
We need to resolve this ASAP. I hope to get the call within today 20
th
Aug 2025
Best Regards
Edna Seah
